name: notify_department_manager
description: notify_department_manager: Send a notification to the department manager about a completed employee action.

employee_id.description: The employee's ID. Format: EMP followed by 6 digits. Example: EMP048271

case_id.description: The case ID for the action being reported. Format: CASE-PREFIX-6digits. Example: CASE-SWP-048271

notification_type.description: The type of action being reported
